paragraphs.text: Kuro (KOO-roh) is an oni pitlord from Kamigawa that was active during the Kami War .

Like other oni, Kuro's dominion over dark and destructive forces twisted him into a being of pure malevolence. Kuro has crinkled, ashen skin, giant curving horns, a sliced belly with a gaping bony pelvis, and twisted, tentacles arms. Like all oni, he has a large third eye present on his forehead.

Kuro offers a deal. Simple bargains are the most tempting, and oni bargains are the simplest of all: eternal life for eternal service. In this manner, Kuro took many as his minions, including the nezumi Ink-Eyes and the ogre Muzan .
